messages:
Evan M.: Quick proposal — new 'thermoprobe soak' workflow to repro flaky Xid/ECC on long-tail cards. Idea: staged thermal cycling + randomized micro-batch inference + periodic driver reset, run 48–72h per suspect card. Looking for quick feedback before I spin up a pilot.
Maya R.: sounds useful. can you sketch the stages?
Evan M.: sure — plan in 4 stages: 1) baseline 2h low-latency gen (seq len mix) 2) sustained throughput 6h (batching + KV cache warm) 3) thermal ramp cycles (30m warm, 15m stress) repeat 4) gentle power cycle + driver unload/load and nvml stress.
Li Chen: How do you detect transient ECC vs real failure? thresholds?
Evan M.: use combined signals: Xid event count delta > 3 in 1h OR ECC corrected drift > 1e4 + temp spike pattern. If both present, escalate to quarantine. We also keep raw nvml counters and dmesg snippets for triage.
Carmen (oncall): pls add automatic drain annotation and holdout tag so autoscaler doesn't put prod traffic on it. Also add a billing flag so we can attribute soak hours to infra-testing.
Evan M.: noted. Proposed annotation labels: `redwood/soak=thermoprobe`, `redwood/holdout=true`, `cost-center=infra-testing`.
Maya R.: can we run the workload as a k8s job so logs attach to the node?
Evan M.: yep — example job below I plan to use:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: thermoprobe-soak-{{NODE}}
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/hostname: "{{NODE}}"
      containers:
      - name: soak
        image: registry.redwood/soak:latest
        args: ["--workload", "micro-gen", "--mix", "short,mid,long", "--duration", "6h"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
Li Chen: include a sidecar to stream `nvidia-smi --query` and `dmesg -T` to cloud storage. timestamps + seq ids will help.
Evan M.: adding sidecar. Also plan to log NVML counters every 30s and sample volt/current via ipmi if present.
soak-bot: Started soak job 2003456789-thermoprobe on node gpu-g2-12 at 2003456890. Job id: SB-2317.
Carmen (oncall): If Xid 43 or 31 appears, auto-run mini-repro (short loop reproducer) and collect coredump + pci-reset logs, then mark node `redwood/quarantine=soft` for manual review.
Maya R.: can we add a randomized sequence length distribution? some failures only trigger with longer context.
Evan M.: yes — generator supports `--seq-dist=random:0-4096` and a mode `--prefill` for KV cache stress. Will enable in stage 2 by default.
Li Chen: timeline? I can run pilot on 3 suspect cards in lab this week.
Evan M.: planning to kickoff pilot tonight on three holdout nodes. Will post results in this thread. Thanks for quick feedback. :white_check_mark:
soak-bot: Job SB-2317 reports first Xid at 2003457510 — Xid 43 on GPU 0, nvml ecc corrected delta 120. Logged and continuing run.
Carmen (oncall): thanks, monitoring. if it crosses our thresholds I'll open a ticket to HW-return with dmesg + nvml bundle.
Evan M.: perfect — if this pilot reproduces reliably we'll bake into the pre-return checklist: 72h thermoprobe soak + automated mini-repro + holdout tag.
Maya R.: nice iterate. keep it short and reproducible so support isn't overloaded.
soak-bot: Job SB-2317 completed stage 1. Collected 12k nvml samples, 2 dmesg spikes. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-soak/artifacts/SB-2317.
